trap.label: would have
trap.wrong: MFA would likely prevented the attack.
trap.right: MFA would likely have prevented the attack.
trap.why: Em português “teria evitado” é uma forma composta e o aluno omite have. Em inglês, would + have + particípio.

fix.right: The network was struck by ransomware.

fix.wrong: Offline backups would have restore the files.
fix.right: Offline backups would have restored the files.

fix.wrong: No evidence had emerge by Monday.
fix.right: No evidence had emerged by Monday.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva na passiva: “Ransomware struck the network.”
rewrite.answer: The network was struck by ransomware.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com would have: “MFA probably prevented it.” (hipótese)
rewrite.answer: MFA would probably have prevented it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com past perfect: “No evidence emerged before then.”
rewrite.answer: No evidence had emerged before then.
